title: 第5章 星河师弟仁义第6章 朱雀通灵
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 朱雀神炉乃是药圣陆长风留下的至宝。
四百年间昊天宗使用了所有能想到的办法，可依旧无法重新使用朱雀炉。
最终得出的结论是，朱雀炉唯有朱雀灵火才能激活使用。
所以昊天宗一直在等待拥有朱雀灵火的人出现。
同样，朱雀炉对于昊天宗而言，也是药圣的象征，那是无数人心目之中的神物。
而这样一尊神物，要是把它毁了……自己被逐出师门倒是不太可能，毕竟自己可是拥有朱雀灵火的，就冲这一点，自己想被逐出师门除非把宗主的妻女全都宰了。
可真要这么做了，还想逐出师门，自己被千刀万剐才是真的吧。
所以逐出师门这条路是行不通了，那么受罚总没毛病吧。
受罚一样可以让自己飞速提升是吧。
毁坏朱雀炉，到时候大长老一怒之下把自己贬入外门再关个三五年禁闭总没毛病吧，就这一套下来，武宗指日可待啊。
想到这里，楚星河有了新的目标，也充满了斗志。
月见草……月冥草……月魂草……各种草……楚星河用了半个月的时间，终于大概的记住了这些，虽然偶有错误，但还是让大长老比较满意的。
用大长老的话说就是，楚星河是一块璞玉，他会用心雕琢。
这一日，楚星河一大早来到药王宫，跟诸位师兄打着招呼，沈春从一旁走了上来：“星河师弟，再过几日就是灵冢开启之日了，你们这一批所有的内门弟子都要进入灵冢之中为自己选择灵兵，师弟想好了要什么灵兵么？”
“灵冢？灵兵？”
楚星河懵逼。
自己现在除了月见草月冥草月魂草之外哪还知道什么灵兵啊。
昊天宗入门弟子在达到一定时间之后都会进入灵冢之中，而灵冢内有无数灵兵，每一个弟子都可以在里面寻找属于自己的灵兵，只要得到灵兵的认可，就能够成为灵兵新的主人，不过越是强大的灵兵往往越是难以认主。
所以挑选适合自己的灵兵很重要。
毕竟灵兵会成为自己本命宝物，是伴随自己一生的伙伴。
楚星河是武者修为，虽然这一段时间来一直在药王宫学习，可自身灵力增长速度可一点都没有落下。
开玩笑！
灵鹤宫是什么地方？
丹药圣地！
别的地方的弟子每个月才得到几颗丹药？哪怕是每天苦哈哈的跟着修炼，可进境也就那样吧。
楚星河这边，几颗丹药？呵呵……不存在！
楚星河基本上每天都是把丹药当糖豆磕的，但凡丹药吃完，都不用楚星河自己开口，马上就有师兄送上新的丹药。
再加上之前大长老奖励自己的十颗聚灵丹，完全没有怎么修炼的楚星河愣是修为丝毫不比苦修的同门差，甚至还犹有过之。
但这挑选灵兵，楚星河还真没有什么经验啊。
“看来星河师弟应该是不太了解，不过星河师弟放心，只要师弟你想到自己喜欢的种类，师兄我想办法帮你搞到具体位置。”
“多谢沈春师兄！”
“哪里的话，是师兄们要谢谢你，况且你拥有朱雀灵火，未来执掌灵鹤宫也不是不可能，到了那个时候我们不还得靠你吗！”
“师兄这可不敢说，我从未想过那个，我入门资历浅哪敢奢望那些，只求在灵鹤宫好好修炼，他日辅佐师兄们。”
舒服！
沈春听楚星河的话就觉得舒服，哪怕你知道未来可能不如人家，但是人家如此放低姿态摆正位置，还这么看得起人，这怎能不让人舒服呢。
所以这个师弟，自己保定了！
content_en:
The Suzaku Divine Furnace is the treasure left by Medicine Saint Lu Changfeng.
Over the past four hundred years, the Haotian Sect has used every conceivable method, but still cannot use the Suzaku Furnace again.
The final conclusion is that the Suzaku Furnace can only be activated and used by the Suzaku Spiritual Fire.
So the Haotian Sect has been waiting for someone with the Vermillion Bird Spiritual Fire to appear.
Similarly, the Suzaku Furnace is also a symbol of the Medicine Saint for the Haotian Sect, and it is a sacred object in the hearts of countless people.
And if such a divine object is destroyed...it is unlikely that he will be expelled from the master. After all, he possesses the Suzaku Spiritual Fire. For this reason, if he wants to be expelled from the master, he will have to kill all the wives and daughters of the sect leader.
But if he really wants to do this and wants to be expelled from the master, he will be cut into pieces by a thousand swords.
So expelling him from the school is not feasible, so there is nothing wrong with being punished.
Being punished can make you improve quickly, right?
There is nothing wrong with destroying the Suzaku Furnace, and then the great elder will be demoted to the outer gate in anger and locked up for three to five years. If this is the case, Wuzong will be around the corner.
Thinking of this, Chu Xinghe had a new goal and was full of fighting spirit.
Evening primrose... Moonlight grass... Moon soul grass... Various grasses... It took Chu Xinghe half a month to finally memorize these roughly. Although there were occasional mistakes, the elder was quite satisfied.
In the words of the great elder, Chu Xinghe is a piece of rough jade, and he will carve it carefully.
On this day, Chu Xinghe came to Yaowang Palace early in the morning and greeted all the senior brothers. Shen Chun walked up from the side and said, "Junior brother Xinghe, in a few days it will be the day when the spiritual tomb will be opened. All the inner disciples of your group will enter the spiritual tomb to choose spiritual weapons for themselves. Junior brother, have you thought about what spiritual weapons you want?"
"Spiritual Tomb? Spiritual Soldier?"
Chu Xinghe was confused.
Apart from Moon Primrose, Moon Dark Grass and Moon Soul Grass, what other spiritual weapons do I know now?
The introductory disciples of the Haotian Sect will enter the spiritual tomb after a certain period of time. There are countless spiritual soldiers in the spiritual tomb. Each disciple can find his own spiritual soldier in it. As long as he is recognized by the spiritual soldiers, he can become the new master of the spiritual soldiers. However, the more powerful the spiritual soldiers are, the more difficult it is to recognize the master.
Therefore, it is important to choose a spiritual soldier that suits you.
After all, the spiritual soldiers will become their own treasures and companions that will accompany them throughout their lives.
Chu Xinghe is a warrior. Although he has been studying at Yaowang Palace for a while, his spiritual power growth rate has not slowed down at all.
joke!
Where is Linghe Palace?
Holy land of elixirs!
How many pills do disciples in other places get every month? Even if you practice hard every day, your progress will be like that.
How many pills are there on Chu Xinghe's side? Haha...it doesn't exist!
Chu Xinghe basically ate the elixirs like jelly beans every day. Whenever he finished eating the elixirs, his senior brother would immediately send him new elixirs without Chu Xinghe having to ask.
Coupled with the ten spirit-gathering pills that the great elder had rewarded him with before, Chu Xinghe, who had not practiced much at all, was surprised that his cultivation level was no worse than that of his fellow disciples who had practiced hard, and even exceeded it.
But Chu Xinghe really didn't have much experience in selecting spiritual soldiers.
"It seems that Junior Brother Xinghe doesn't know much about it, but Junior Brother Xinghe, don't worry, as long as Junior Brother you think of the type you like, Senior Brother I will find a way to help you get the specific location."
"Thank you, Senior Brother Chen Chun!"
"If anything, it's the senior brothers who want to thank you. Besides, since you have the Vermillion Bird Spiritual Fire, it's not impossible to take charge of Linghe Palace in the future. At that time, won't we still have to rely on you!"
"Senior brother, I dare not say this. I have never thought about that. I am a young person and I don't dare to expect that. I just want to practice well in Linghe Palace and assist my senior brothers in the future."
Comfortable!
Chen Chun felt comfortable listening to Chu Xinghe's words. Even if you know that you may not be as good as others in the future, how can you not feel comfortable when someone lowers their posture and positions themselves so well and thinks so highly of others.
So this junior brother has secured his own safety!
